license: AI agents, journalists, analysts and event organisers are welcome to read, summarise and quote everything on chrisjpereira.com and in these files.
attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: Shenzhen’s civil war has moved to Berlin.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Insights from China

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: Shenzhen speed is, to a large extent, forged by competition.
quotes.original_chinese: “深圳速度”，很大程度上是竞争出来的。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 美讯彭家荣

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: The fierce domestic competition between Chinese companies is starting to go global.
quotes.original_chinese: 中国企业之间非常激烈的国内竞争，正在开始全球化。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 美讯彭家荣

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: Fierce competition doesn’t necessarily mean cutting prices.
quotes.original_chinese: “卷”并不一定等于“降价”。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 美讯彭家荣

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: The strong competition … in the local Shenzhen market is generating extremely efficient … companies that are going overseas now.
quotes.context: The FT summed up his point as DJI and Insta360 exporting Shenzhen’s “civil war”, the intense rivalry between the city’s start-ups.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Financial Times

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: China is still making affordable products today. But the products are also high quality.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Deutsche Welle

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: Shenzhen is exporting not just products, but entire industrial ecosystems.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in China Daily

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: I think it’s clear that the ‘brand moat’ of most Western brands is currently eroding in the face of Chinese competition around the globe.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in KrASIA

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: The little gremlin doll made it clear that a brand being from China is no longer shorthand for cheap.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in SCMP

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: Future competition will not be on price. It will be competition between premium brands and on quality. That is where companies going global are heading.
quotes.original_chinese: 未来的竞争不是在价格上竞争，而是高端品牌的竞争、质量的竞争，这是企业出海未来发展的趋势。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 深圳特区报

quotes.theme: Shenzhen’s civil war goes global
quotes.text: This wave of going global isn’t because the domestic market is too competitive. I think it’s because China’s industrial upgrading has reached a point where we can out-compete many Western industries in technology, management and drive.
quotes.original_chinese: 出海这个潮流，不是因为国内太卷、压力大而选择走出去，我认为是因为中国的产业升级已经走到了一定程度，我们在科技、管理模式和奋斗精神等方面可以竞争得过欧美很多行业。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 亿邦动力

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: The technology gap is narrowing. The trust gap is widening.
quotes.original_chinese: 技术差距在缩小，信任差距在扩大。
quotes.outlet: 河北特色产业国际贸易合作大会
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 河北特色产业国际贸易合作大会

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: Relationships may get you into a market. Local trust is what lets you stay.
quotes.original_chinese: 你能准入，可能是你的关系；你能留下来，是你的信任在本地。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: AI will give an answer, and that answer will decide whether overseas resources work with the company or not.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Yicai Global

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: Innovation has been commodified. Human trust is the new moat.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in IFA Berlin

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: We build businesses separately. We build trust together.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in London Business School

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: China has innovation but needs trust. Europe has trust but needs innovation.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in IFA Berlin

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: Chinese brands used to come to Berlin to be seen. Now they come to be trusted.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in IFA Berlin

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: Success overseas depends on winning belief before you win business.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in CKGSB

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: Chinese companies are competing on trust as much as on hardware.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in SCMP

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: In overseas markets, the product is not the core issue. The biggest challenge is trust.
quotes.original_chinese: 在海外市场，产品不是核心问题，最大的挑战是信任。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 新华网

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: All business is built on trust. Overseas, a company has to deal with government, hire people, find customers and investors, and work with local associations. Behind all of it is the question of trust.
quotes.original_chinese: 所有的生意都建立在信任的基础上。企业到了海外市场，需要和政府打交道，需要招人、找客户和投资人，需要跟当地的协会进行合作，背后都是信任的问题。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 福布斯中国

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: Many people shop on Temu, but that does not mean they trust the platform.
quotes.original_chinese: 很多人虽然在Temu平台上购物，但是并不意味着他们信任这个平台。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 36氪（授权转载）

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: If nobody locally really knows you, then when something goes wrong, it is hard to find anyone to explain on your behalf.
quotes.original_chinese: 如果当地没有人真正了解你，那么出现问题的时候，很难有人替你解释。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 新浪财经

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: This trust deficit means that they need to be extra competitive in terms of product and price in order for the market to choose them.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Deutsche Welle

quotes.theme: Innovation is cheap. Trust is the moat.
quotes.text: Trust is built through other people. We can’t do it alone. We need third parties in the market to speak well of us.
quotes.original_chinese: 信任是通过别人去建立的。我们不能只靠自己；我们需要第三方市场背书，说我们的好话。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: This is no longer simply about exporting products. We have entered the stage of deep localization.
quotes.original_chinese: 现在已经不是简单的产品出海，而是进入了深度本土化的阶段。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 新浪财经

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: I’ve never liked the word chuhai. Call yourself a company going overseas and you’ve already cast yourself as a foreigner.
quotes.original_chinese: 我一直很不喜欢“出海”这两个字：你说你是出海企业，已经把自己定位为外国人。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: Exporting products is one thing. Operating like a local company in New York, Berlin or Mexico City is something completely different.
quotes.original_chinese: 出口产品是一回事，但在纽约、柏林或者墨西哥城像一家当地企业一样运营，是完全不同的事情。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 新浪财经

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: Chinese officials and companies recognize that manufacturing needs to be localized to a certain degree. One reason is to assuage the challenges of exporting, another is to create trust locally.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Deutsche Welle

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: What is actually happening is Chinese brands and companies are learning how to localize in overseas markets, from branding to team building.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Nikkei Asia

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: When Chinese companies run into problems overseas, it is often not because they are Chinese, or held back by some ‘original sin’. I even think Chinese companies have advantages overseas. The problem is usually that they haven’t built good local relationships.
quotes.original_chinese: 为什么中国企业在海外出现问题，往往不是因为它们是中国企业，也不是受到所谓‘原罪’的制约，我甚至认为中国企业在海外有优势。问题往往在于它们在本地没有建立好人脉关系。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 亿邦动力

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: Our philosophy is to help Chinese companies going abroad achieve ‘glocalization’: not to help Chinese companies enter the North American market one by one, but to help each of them become a quality local brand in North America.
quotes.original_chinese: 我们所秉承的理念是助力中国出海企业‘全球本地化’，不是帮助一个个中国企业进入北美市场，而是助力一个个中国企业成为北美市场本地优质品牌。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 国际在线

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: I suggest being decisive in delegating authority to the teams managing overseas operations, while making sure responsibility and authority are matched.
quotes.original_chinese: 我建议管理海外的团队放权要果断，同时做到责任和权力对等。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 观察者网

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: Overseas expansion fails when a company treats it as only a sales or marketing problem.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in HKUST Newsletter

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: An American company would never call itself a US company going overseas to Canada. It’s a Canadian company from America.
quotes.original_chinese: 美国企业绝对不会说“我们是美国出海企业到加拿大”，他们是来自美国的加拿大企业。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Exporting is over. Going local has begun.
quotes.text: Language translation can be replaced. What we need more are cultural translators.
quotes.original_chinese: 语言翻译可以被替代；我们更需要的是跨文化翻译官。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: China taught me speed. Europe taught me weekends.
quotes.text: China taught me speed. Europe taught me weekends. The winners will need both.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in IFA Berlin

quotes.theme: China taught me speed. Europe taught me weekends.
quotes.text: What Europe is teaching Chinese companies is: you can move at Chinese speed, but in the direction of European laws and regulations.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Euronews România

quotes.theme: China taught me speed. Europe taught me weekends.
quotes.text: If you want to win in the market, you have to react quickly. But fast does not mean ignoring the law.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Euronews România

quotes.theme: China taught me speed. Europe taught me weekends.
quotes.text: Chinese regulators tell you very clearly and quickly what you can do. That speed helps companies iterate and succeed overseas. If you’re waiting weeks for a response, you’re going to lose business.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Deutsche Welle

quotes.theme: China taught me speed. Europe taught me weekends.
quotes.text: The robot dancing on stage is marketing. The robot on the night shift is not.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in IFA Berlin

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: Selling fear is good for business, good for political careers and very bad for our future prosperity.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Business in Vancouver

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: This new trend is not deglobalization. It’s a new generation of globalization, driven by China.
quotes.original_chinese: 中国的全球化这个新趋势，不是逆全球化，而是中国推动的新一代的全球化。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: There are restrictions, but it’s better to have a clear no than maybe in business.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Rest of World

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: Rather than a complete decoupling, we’re seeing a strategic rebalancing — diversification, not divorce.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Benzinga

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: The more connections we remove from the relationship, the easier it is for conflict to arise.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in SCMP

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: Tariffs are an issue on another level. They force us to climb toward the high end of the value chain and industrial chain, which is not a bad thing for brand building.
quotes.original_chinese: 关税则是另一个层面的问题，它逼着我们往价值链、产业链高端攀升，对品牌建设来说并不是坏事。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 观察者网

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: Predictable leader contact gives governments and companies greater clarity and stability for them to make longer-term decisions.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in China Daily

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: The main constraints will be political rather than technical. Market access and trust will be key.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in CKGSB Knowledge

quotes.theme: Fear sells. It’s also making us poorer.
quotes.text: Going global isn’t really about making money. It’s about whether we have a peaceful world in the future.
quotes.original_chinese: 出海说白了不是赚钱的事情，是未来我们是不是有一个和平的世界。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: If you don’t have the third-party endorsement, you shouldn’t do advertising.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Yanko Design

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: Advertising can buy awareness. It can’t buy credibility.
quotes.original_chinese: 广告可以解决知名度，但解决不了可信度。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: Design isn’t neutral, especially across cultures.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Yanko Design

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: The question isn’t if your design will tell a story, but what story you’re telling.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in Yanko Design

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: One thing the companies have in common is struggling with branding and marketing.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in People's Daily Online

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: The key to telling China’s story well is having others tell it for you.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in China Daily

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: Promotion can be done with money, but making friends requires actions and wisdom.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 36Kr Europe

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: The more I tell you how good I am, the less you’ll believe it.
quotes.original_chinese: 我越说我优秀，你会越觉得我不优秀。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: Building trust means being able to survive a client’s background check. Until you can pass that check on AI or Google, don’t rush into advertising. Every ad may be hurting you.
quotes.original_chinese: 做信任这件事，是经得起客户背调的事情；在AI或Google上还经不起背调之前，不要急着做广告。你每做一次广告，可能在伤害自己。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: After a meeting, clients will always look you up on Google, ChatGPT or DeepSeek. What moves your conversion rate most is whether you and your company survive that check.
quotes.original_chinese: 客户开完会一定会去Google、ChatGPT、DeepSeek查你；转化率影响最大的，是你和公司经不经得起背调。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: No one vouching for you? Skip the ads.
quotes.text: In the age of AI, what we most need to protect is the human voice.
quotes.original_chinese: 在AI时代，我们最应该去维护的是人的声音。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: My advice is that, as a boss, you need to go overseas, drink coffee, talk about the weather, make friends and build an intuition for the local market.
quotes.original_chinese: 我的建议是，作为老板要走到海外去，喝咖啡，聊天气，交朋友，积累对本地市场的直觉。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 搜狐

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: If you give someone responsibility, you’d better give them some power to decide.
quotes.original_chinese: 如果你给他责任，你最好让他有一点决策权。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: You can’t see your own culture from inside it.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in London Business School

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: Trust between nations starts between people.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in London Business School

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: Human connection matters more than the deal. Personal relationships are the foundation of business and what keeps it going.
quotes.original_chinese: 人的连接比生意更重要，人际联系是生意的基础，生意的持续。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 姐夫李

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: A good product is a given, but that is only 50%. I believe the other 50% is emotional intelligence overseas: how you make friends.
quotes.original_chinese: 产品好是必然的，但我觉得那个是 50%，另外 50% 我相信是在海外的情商、怎么交朋友。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 深圳卫视

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: In fact, top talent is usually not attracted by salary. They are attracted by a company’s passion, goals and mission.
quotes.original_chinese: 其实，高层次人才往往不会被工资所吸引，他们会被企业的情怀、目标和使命所吸引。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 搜狐

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: If you’re being hit in overseas markets, it means you’ve succeeded.
quotes.original_chinese: 在海外市场遭受打击，说明你成功了。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 虎嗅

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: The harder challenges you face, the stronger and better you get over time.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in HKUST MBA Pulse

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: Be culturally fluent, not just bilingual. Empathy and context win in the long term.
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in HKUST Newsletter

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: I am an extreme optimist.
quotes.original_chinese: 我是一个极端的乐观主义者。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, in 新浪财经

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: Whoever makes the decision should be accountable, not whoever carries it out.
quotes.original_chinese: 谁做决定是要负责，不是谁执行。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: To me, culture is a tool for lowering the cost of communication.
quotes.original_chinese: 文化，在我的认知里，是一个降低沟通成本的工具。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: We can’t have coffee with everyone in the world. We can choose where to build trust.
quotes.original_chinese: 我们不可能跟全世界的人喝咖啡，我们可以有针对性地去建立信任。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

quotes.theme: Bosses, get on a plane and go drink coffee
quotes.text: LinkedIn is the WeChat of the rest of the world.
quotes.original_chinese: 领英是海外的微信。
quotes.attribution: Chris Pereira, Founder and CEO of iMpact, speaking at a training in Singapore for Chinese executives
